summary: Frontend-only React Kindred Wealth Studio app tested end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL. All critical user flows passed: signup, dashboard KPIs/charts/holdings, asset CRUD with search/filter, transaction CRUD with filters, analytics rendering, goals CRUD, sidebar navigation, logout, login, and localStorage persistence across reload.

issues: Recharts emits repeated console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Charts render fine eventually but the warnings indicate ResponsiveContainer parent has 0 height on first paint. Cosmetic only — recommend giving chart wrappers an explicit minHeight or fixed aspect ratio.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add minHeight/aspect to Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers to silence width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on Dashboard and Analytics.
critical_code_review_comments: App is well-structured and uses data-testid attributes consistently across pages, dialogs and nav links — excellent test affordance.
Auth is fully mocked in localStorage as agreed (frontend-only demo) — initUserData seeding works on first login per-user (verified: 7 assets, 10 transactions, 3 goals seeded for new user).
Mutations write through to localStorage and survive a hard reload (verified by adding a goal and reloading).
Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings; consider explicit min dimensions to remove dev console noise.
test_credentials: Created on the fly: email=eleanor+<timestamp>@kindred.test, password=wealth123, name='Eleanor Hayes'. Auth is local-only, so any new email/password works.
seed_data_creation: App auto-seeds per-user on first login via initUserData (assets, transactions, goals). No external seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only app — DO NOT test backend APIs. Public URL https://money-flow-429.preview.emergentagent.com/ serves the React app. Use unique email per signup run because users persist in localStorage of the test browser (clear localStorage if reusing). Auto-accept window.confirm via page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) — the app uses native confirm for delete operations. data-testids documented in the request all exist and work. The protected-route negative test must clear ALL auth state and do a full page navigation (page.goto with reload) — simply removing 'km_session' mid-session keeps the React AuthProvider in-memory state alive until next load.

verified_flows.transactions_list_filter: PASS (10 seeded; buy filter retains 10 — seed contains all-buy txs)
